name: What kind of preparation is needed before remodel painting?

mainEntity.name: What kind of preparation is needed before remodel painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is essential for a lasting paint job. This typically includes thoroughly cleaning surfaces to remove dirt and grease, repairing any cracks or holes with spackle or drywall compound, and sanding rough areas to create a smooth base. Taping off trim, baseboards, and covering furniture and floors are also critical steps to protect unpainted areas from paint splatters. Investing time in preparation significantly impacts the final look and durability of the paint finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation involves cleaning, repairing cracks and holes, sanding surfaces, and protecting unpainted areas with tape and covers.
